human_review_text: This paper presents sequence-level certainty as a common theme over hallucination. The authors categorize sequence-level certainty into probabilistic certainty and semantic certainty and explore the correlation between sequence-level certainty and the level of hallucination. Based on the observation, the authors proposed a decoding-time method called Certainty-based Response Ranking (CRR) to mitigate hallucination. The experimental results show CRR can reduce model hallucination under certain settings.
